title: P2 principal.data_request: request
description: A person's request about their own data (/mydata erase or /mydata export in a direct chat) or a request by a person with admin:people about a principal of their tenant: a SubjectRequest of kind erase in v0.1, export since v0.2 (SEC-11, D-76). A confirmed erasure goes as an erasure request with the reason subject_request. A copy (kind export) is only about oneself and goes only to the requester, encrypted with the public key the requester supplies (recipient_key); admin:people cannot request a copy of another person (SEC-10, LCY-2).

subject.description: Only a person with admin:people and only for kind erase: whom the request is about; without the field the request is about oneself.

recipient_key.description: From v0.2, only for kind export and required for it: the requester's public key; the copy is encrypted with it and goes only to the requester (SEC-10).
